Our story

From best friends to us

24 September 2022

A gas station in Oula

The most random place in the world. That's where I met you. I didn't know that ordinary day was the start of everything.

The brave night

You made a big decision, all by yourself

We were still best friends. You took one of the hardest decisions of your life, and you did it with your head up. I was so proud of you that night. I still am.

New Year

Still "just friends"

After a house party that really sucked, we made a random decision, like always, and drove to Sokhna at 4 AM. It was one of the greatest days of my life. And that's my favorite thing about us: we are both crazy.

31 January 2024

The day you became mine

No more "best friends". From this day, you were my girl. Best decision I ever made.

3 February 2024

The day I'll never forget

Some days stay with you forever. This is mine. You know why.

Valentine's Day

Roses for my girl

Look at you. Holding those roses like a princess. I swear the flowers looked worse next to you.

One day

Still you. Still me.

Grey hair, same crazy girl, same lucky guy. This is the plan. No changes allowed.

A letter, from me

tap the envelope

My Manoona,

Happy birthday, my love. You are 23 today, and I'm so lucky that I got to be next to you for four of them.

We met at a gas station in Oula, of all places. You were my best friend first. Then you became my comfort zone. Now you are my home.

Thank you for loving me in your crazy, insane way. Thank you for caring about me, for respecting me, and for never giving up on me, even on the hard days.

I promise to keep making you laugh, keep kissing your forehead, and keep choosing you, every single day.

I love you more than words, and more than this whole website. بحبك

Yours, always,
Adam
